selection_rule: Among RED products whose footprint contains the site point (COLOR only when no RED covers it): the newest near-nadir one (emission <= 10 deg); if none is near-nadir, the smallest emission angle, newest on ties. RED is preferred because its browse covers the full 6 km swath; COLOR covers only the central strip.
